overview: The Commission addressed safety concerns regarding the abundance of acorns in the park, coordinated maintenance for the new shed and irrigation system, and approved the expenditure of remaining grant funds for new equipment.

items.title: Off-Leash Subcommittee Proposal
items.summary: The Commission discussed the possibility of forming a subcommittee to address community interest in off-leash hours and outreach.

items.title: Acorn Toxicity and Safety
items.summary: Following reports of dogs becoming ill, the Commission decided to install permanent educational signage about acorn toxicity rather than removing healthy oak trees.

items.title: Volunteer Recruitment
items.summary: Members discussed strategies to address a volunteer shortage, including targeted social media outreach and student engagement at Tufts University.

items.title: Shed Finishing and Decor
items.summary: The Commission planned to finish the new shed door with stain and decorative stencils.

items.title: Equipment and Budget Allocation
items.summary: Approved the purchase of a multi-level agility platform and an additional bench using approximately $2,700 in remaining grant funds.

items.title: Irrigation and Rice Stone Maintenance
items.summary: The Commission identified a need for additional rice stone to cover exposed irrigation heads and prevent tripping hazards caused by frost heaves.
